name: Maldon
reason: Rule 1: Visit Victoria region page names Maldon; National Trust-preserved gold-rush streetscape, mines, steam railway. Obvious draw.

name: Woodend
reason: Visit Macedon Ranges village page plus Wikivoyage Macedon Ranges section list it as a town to stop in; second-tier village stop.

name: Mount Macedon Memorial Cross
reason: Tourism board features the summit cross and reserve views and walks; open landmark, 30+ min.

name: Black Hill Reserve
reason: One board source (bushwalk and wine tasting); only one counted source, short walk. Case for: named by board. Against: single source, minor reserve.

reason: Visit Macedon Ranges listing and botanic-gardens feature: 1858 heritage gardens, Campaspe River walk access; free open place.

name: Kyneton Museum
reason: Rule 1/2: local museum; no visitor source found naming it as a draw.

reason: Visit Macedon Ranges listing and Parks Victoria page (Turpins Falls Scenic Reserve, reopened 2026 with viewing platform). Note official name Turpins Falls; check access status.

name: Lancefield
reason: Rule 1/2: small town, no named attraction found in a visitor source.

name: Clunes
reason: Visit Victoria region page and Visit Hepburn Shire: booktown, gold-rush Fraser St streetscape, museums; permanent draw (festival itself excluded).

name: Creswick
reason: Rule 1/3: no town-level draw named; its attractions (Blue Waters, Creswick Regional Park) are covered as spots.

name: Creswick Museum
reason: Rule 2: small weekend-opening local museum; no visitor source found.

reason: Parks Victoria names the granite caves, lookout and camping (bushranger hideout); distinct walk-in site, though within Kooyoora State Park (objection: part of larger park).

name: Seymour Railway Heritage Centre
reason: One Wikivoyage listing; short visit, opening limited. Case for: heritage railway site. Against: thin evidence.

name: Valley of the Liquid Ambers
reason: Rule 3: picnic park, no visitor source found.

reason: National park with Mt Ida and Viewing Rock lookouts, walks, Graytown gold relics, camping (Parks Victoria page and Wikivoyage Heathcote). National parks qualify.

name: Lake Eppalock
reason: Bendigo Region tourism and City of Greater Bendigo list it: swimming, sailing, fishing, picnics, free entry; day-trip draw.

name: O'Keefe Rail Trail
reason: Bendigo Region tourism page: ~50 km flat trail Bendigo to Heathcote past Lake Eppalock; promoted trail (pin at midpoint).

name: Lyonville Mineral Springs
reason: Rule 2/3: roadside spring tap, one thin Wikivoyage listing, short stop.

name: Hepburn Pool
reason: Rule 2/3: disused heritage pool inside Hepburn Mineral Springs Reserve (part of a larger spot), swimming no longer allowed; no counted source.

name: Sailors Falls
reason: Parks page names it on the Mineral Springs Loop. For: named waterfall. Against: part of loop already listed, short stop.

name: The Blowhole

reason: Wikivoyage Ballarat recommends hiring a bike for the 53 km off-road trail; promoted rail trail like O'Keefe.

name: Ballarat Tramway Museum
reason: Wikivoyage Ballarat: historic tram rides along 1.3 km through the Botanical Gardens, weekends and holidays; permanent venue. Objection: limited opening.

reason: Parks Victoria scenic reserve with summit lookout and walking track (extinct volcano); second-tier outlook near Ballarat.
